strings.en: Diagnosing a nail problem means looking at more than just the nail — it takes a whole work-up:

strings.en: Mechanical injury and onychomycosis often coexist. Once onychomycosis is confirmed, Taiwan's NHI covers these oral antifungals:

strings.zh: 糖尿病人趾甲問題不能拖。研究數據：
strings.en: Toenail problems in diabetes cannot be left to drift. The data:

strings.zh: 糖尿病人灰指甲治療要特別注意：藥物-藥物交互作用較多（尤其 itraconazole 與 statin、warfarin、心律不整藥）、復發率較高、phenol matricectomy 因血管病變傷口癒合慢、感染風險較高。
strings.en: Special points for onychomycosis treatment in diabetes: more drug–drug interactions (especially itraconazole with statins, warfarin, and antiarrhythmics), higher recurrence rates, and slower wound healing plus higher infection risk after phenol matricectomy due to vasculopathy.

strings.zh: Zaias 等人提出 AGNUS 假說：兩腳長度或結構不對稱會破壞正常步態 → 落地壓力不均 → 趾甲反覆受重複摩擦 → 甲下角化 + 甲剝離 + 內側甲板彎曲，看起來和灰指甲幾乎一模一樣。常伴隨間歇性下背痛。Hallux valgus / rigidus 特別容易誘發 AGNUS。
strings.en: Zaias and colleagues proposed the AGNUS hypothesis: asymmetry in leg length or structure disrupts normal gait → uneven foot-strike pressure → repeated nail friction → subungual hyperkeratosis, onycholysis, and medial nail-plate curvature that looks almost identical to onychomycosis. Intermittent low-back pain is a common accompaniment. Hallux valgus or hallux rigidus particularly predisposes to AGNUS.

strings.zh: 骨關節囊液漏出形成 myxoid cyst（黏液囊腫），按位置分三型：
strings.en: Leakage of synovial fluid forms a myxoid (digital mucous) cyst, divided into three positional types:

strings.zh: 手術切除治癒率 ~95%、復發率 2-21%；穿刺抽吸復發率 ~50%。
strings.en: Surgical excision cure rate ~95% (recurrence 2–21%); needle aspiration recurrence is ~50%.

strings.zh: 給一般民眾的建議行動順序：
strings.en: Suggested order of actions for the general public:

strings.zh: 趾甲問題不像皮膚問題，1-2 週看不到變化，腳趾甲長一輪要 12-18 個月。期間「停掉誘發因子 + 修剪正確 + 必要時治療灰指甲」三件事一起做，才會看到改善。
strings.en: Unlike skin problems, toenail issues don't show changes within 1–2 weeks — a full toenail takes 12–18 months to grow out. During that time you have to combine three things to see improvement: remove the trigger, trim correctly, and treat onychomycosis if it's present.

strings.zh: 機械性傷害會讓灰指甲容易感染進來——所以兩者常合併存在。
strings.en: Mechanical injury makes it easier for onychomycosis to take hold, so the two commonly coexist.

strings.zh: Morton 趾、拇指外翻、扁平足、開張足都會讓趾甲變樣，常被誤診為灰指甲
strings.en: Morton toe, hallux valgus, flat foot, and splay foot all change the nail's appearance and are frequently misdiagnosed as onychomycosis

strings.zh: 選鞋四原則：寬深鞋頭、低跟（< 30-35 mm）、足弓支撐、可調綁帶
strings.en: Four shoe-selection principles: wide and deep toe box, low heel (< 30–35 mm), arch support, and adjustable straps

strings.zh: 糖尿病人比一般人多 2.77 倍容易得灰指甲，且與足部潰瘍風險相關，任何趾甲變化都要積極處理
strings.en: People with diabetes are 2.77× more likely to develop onychomycosis, which correlates with foot-ulcer risk, so any nail change deserves prompt attention

strings.zh: 看醫師前可以準備：常穿的鞋子（或照片）、變化的時間軸、糖尿病/血液循環/關節炎病史
strings.en: Things to bring to your visit: the shoes you wear most often (or photos), a timeline of the changes, and any history of diabetes, circulation problems, or arthritis

strings.zh: 大拇趾外翻 / 槌狀趾 / 任何明顯腳型異常合併趾甲不適
strings.en: Hallux valgus, hammertoe, or any obvious foot-shape abnormality combined with nail discomfort

strings.zh: 確認灰指甲後想開始治療（健保口服藥需要由醫師處方）
strings.en: After onychomycosis is confirmed and you want to start treatment (NHI-covered oral antifungals require a physician prescription)

strings.zh: 趾甲被夾傷、被砸傷後變黑、變痛、滲液
strings.en: A toenail that turned black, became painful, or began to ooze after being crushed or struck

strings.zh: 甲剝離者每 2 週修剪剝離部分；保持乾燥
strings.en: For onycholysis, trim the detached portion every 2 weeks and keep the area dry

strings.zh: 處理腳型問題：物理治療、足科評估，嚴重者考慮拇指外翻矯正手術
strings.en: Address the underlying foot shape: physical therapy, podiatry assessment, and bunion surgery for severe hallux valgus

strings.zh: 糖尿病合併扁平足 71.2%、爪狀趾 94.8%、拇指外翻 66%
strings.en: Diabetes coexists with flat foot in 71.2%, claw toes in 94.8%, and hallux valgus in 66% of patients
Ingrown toenail prevalence 13–32%

strings.zh: 復發率較高、藥物-藥物交互作用較多
strings.en: Higher recurrence rates and more drug–drug interactions

strings.zh: 血糖控制不佳（HbA1c↑）與 onychomycosis 顯著相關（P = .039）
strings.en: Poor glycemic control (rising HbA1c) is significantly associated with onychomycosis (P = .039)

strings.zh: Phenol matricectomy 在糖尿病人傷口癒合較慢、感染風險較高
strings.en: Phenol matricectomy in diabetes is followed by slower wound healing and a higher infection risk

strings.zh: 先停掉太緊或鞋頭太尖的鞋子，換成寬深、低跟、有足弓支撐的鞋
strings.en: First, stop wearing shoes that are too tight or have a narrow toe box — switch to wide, deep, low-heeled shoes with arch support

strings.zh: 看診前準備：常穿的鞋子（或照片）、變化的時間軸、糖尿病 / 血液循環 / 關節炎病史
strings.en: Bring to your visit: the shoes you most often wear (or photos), a timeline of the changes, and any history of diabetes, circulatory disease, or arthritis

strings.zh: 圖一　趾甲的構造：俯視可看到甲板、半月、甲褶；側面剖視可看到甲基質（產生甲板）、甲床（佔比 75-85%）與下方的遠端趾骨。手指甲約 3 mm/月、腳趾甲約 1 mm/月生長。
strings.en: Figure 1. Anatomy of the nail unit. The top view shows the nail plate, lunula, and nail folds; the lateral cross-section shows the nail matrix (which produces the plate), the nail bed (which accounts for 75–85%), and the distal phalanx beneath. Fingernails grow about 3 mm/month and toenails about 1 mm/month.

strings.zh: 圖三　12 種趾甲機械性變形圖鑑。每一種都對應特定的鞋子壓力或腳型問題，幾乎都會被民眾誤以為是灰指甲。診斷時要看「分布、單側 vs 雙側、是否合併腳型異常」。
strings.en: Figure 3. Atlas of 12 mechanical toenail dystrophies. Each one corresponds to a specific shoe-pressure or foot-shape problem, and nearly all are mistaken by patients for onychomycosis. Diagnosis hinges on distribution, unilateral vs bilateral involvement, and any associated foot-shape abnormality.

strings.en: Figure 4. The four most common foot-shape abnormalities and their nail manifestations. Hallux valgus has a prevalence of 23–36%, and flat foot coexists with diabetes in up to 71.2% of patients.
